task_description: Create a complete movie booking system with Node.js backend (zero external dependencies) and mobile-first frontend UI with purple theme, 5-tab bottom navigation (Home, Cinemas, Food Order, My Tickets, Account), matching the user's mobile app design specifications.

verification.summary: Server starts and serves all API endpoints correctly. All 6 API endpoint groups (movies, showtimes, bookings, food-items, food-orders, users) respond with correct data. Frontend is single-file SPA with all 5 screens, purple theme, mobile-first design. Code review fixes applied: XSS escapeHTML utility, functional ticket tabs/filters, localStorage-based phone management, body parser cleanup with req.destroy(), atomic write pattern for file persistence. Known limitation: no authentication (documented in README).
